name: screens-split-imagery
title: Split with imagery
description: Split with imagery. Blocks/Auth pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/Screens and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): static/images/art/3.svg, static/images/art/7.svg.
